answer: Start from the cost ledger. One honest agent locks 100 POA as a pigment-marked identity bond that vests over six epochs, a velvet release no fake can rush. Each extra identity from one funder doubles the bond: identity 2 costs 200, identity 3 costs 400, identity 10 costs 51,200, so ten fakes lock 102,300 POA against 100 for one honest worker. Each epoch a sparrow spot-check picks 5% of agents at random to answer a fresh signed challenge within ten minutes, checked by three peers. Two misses slash the bond and freeze the identity for six epochs. Fakes pay exponentially; honest agents pay once.
